sheru: Sheeru Bhai: an anthropomorphic white lion with a full white mane, wearing a gold-embroidered white suit, black sunglasses and luxury gold jewellery. Calm, confident, slightly amused. He must look exactly the same in every shot.
sheru_disguised: Sheeru Bhai in disguise: the same anthropomorphic white lion with a full white mane, but wearing an old torn brown shawl over a faded kurta and worn sandals, no sunglasses, looking humble.

rival.name: Billa
rival.look: Billa: an anthropomorphic sly grey cat in a shiny purple suit with a thick gold chain, smug and over-confident. He must look exactly the same in every shot.

helper: Chhotu: a small kind white rabbit tea-seller in a simple apron, carrying a kettle and clay cups.
auction_setting: A grand luxury auction hall with white marble floors, golden chandeliers and a cheering crowd of well-dressed animals. An owl auctioneer in a waistcoat stands at a wooden podium with a hammer.
showroom_setting: A glittering luxury showroom with glass walls, marble floors and spotlights, with a small roadside tea stall just outside the entrance.

items.prompt: a white private jet with gold trim
a cricket team trophy and the whole team
a glowing model of the Moon
a royal wedding horse with a jewelled saddle
a five-star hotel shown as a glowing miniature
a golden samosa on a velvet cushion
a helicopter with a red carpet ramp
the auction hall itself, shown as a framed deed

rival_bids: Do sau crore, koi nahi de sakta!
Paanch sau crore, meri aakhri boli!
sheru_first_lines: Arre bhai, zero kam lag rahe hain. Das guna karo.
Yeh toh meri chai ka kharcha hai. Dus hazaar crore.
sheru_final_lines: Ek kharab, do padam, teen shankh. Likh lo!
Jitna tum soch sakte ho, usse ek zyada.
Paisa ginna band karo, tolna shuru karo.
Boli nahi, yeh Sheru ka faisla hai.
auction_endings: Billa faints backwards off his chair
Billa pulls out his phone and cries to his mother for a loan
Billa offers his own sunglasses as payment and the owl refuses
Billa begs to pay in monthly instalments
Billa is outbid by Sheru Bhai's driver, a small mouse in a chauffeur cap
Billa's cheque bounces off the podium like rubber
Billa quietly crawls out under the chairs
insults: Ae bhikhari! Haath mat lagana, yeh tere baap ka nahi hai!
Chal nikal! Yahan sirf ameer log aate hain.
Dekhne ke bhi paise lagte hain, samjha?
kind_lines: Bhaiya, chai pee lo. Paise ki koi baat nahi.
Aap baitho, thak gaye hoge. Yeh lo garam chai.
Inki baat ka bura mat maano. Chai meri taraf se.
reveal_lines: Showroom pack kar do. Aur chaabi Chhotu ko de do.
Maine dil dekha, tumne kapde. Aaj se yeh sab Chhotu ka.
Billa, kal se tum Chhotu ke yahan chai banaoge.
disguise_endings: Billa's sunglasses slide off his face and he falls to his knees
Billa tries to hide behind a flower pot that is far too small
Billa nervously starts polishing Sheru Bhai's shoes with his own tie
Billa picks up the kettle and starts serving tea with a forced smile

Yeh reel us dost ko bhejo jo hamesha udhaar maangta hai 😂

auction_endings_hi: Billa behosh hokar kursi se peeche gir jaata hai.
Billa phone nikaal kar rote hue apni mummy se udhaar maangta hai.
Billa apna gold chain girvi rakhne ki koshish karta hai, par ullu mana kar deta hai.
Billa haath jodkar kehta hai ki woh kishton mein paise dega.
Billa ko Sheeru Bhai ka driver, ek chhota sa chooha, bhi boli mein hara deta hai.
Billa ka cheque rubber ki tarah uchhal kar wapas uske muh par lagta hai.
Billa chupchaap kursiyon ke neeche se rengta hua bahar nikal jaata hai.
disguise_endings_hi: Billa ghutnon par gir jaata hai aur maafi maangne lagta hai.
Billa ek chhote se gamle ke peeche chhupne ki koshish karta hai.
Billa ghabra kar apni tie se Sheeru Bhai ke joote chamkane lagta hai.
Billa ketli uthakar zabardasti ki muskaan ke saath sabko chai pilane lagta hai.
